messages:
izzy_sales: Tara on the demo is seeing 403s when calling generate and 403 on embeddings. Says error mentions project claim. Can infra take a look?

tara_acme: Getting '403: project claim mismatch' for /v1/generate and '403: scope missing (embeddings)' for /v1/embeddings. Using key from portal and header X-Redwood-Project: acme-main.

izzy_sales: thanks. Can you paste the curl (mask key) and timeline?

tara_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.test.9xyz" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-main" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}'

neha_se: quick checks: 1) project header must match the project bound to the key (case-sensitive). 2) embeddings error implies the key may not have embeddings scope.

omar_infra: pulling auth logs now.

omar_infra: log snippet: 
```
auth: key=sk.test.9xyz bound_project=acme-temp-81 tenant=acme-org scopes=[generate] request_header=acme-main decision=DENY (project mismatch)
auth: key=sk.test.oldkey bound_project=acme-main tenant=acme-org scopes=[generate,embeddings] decision=ALLOW
```
So two things: the key you presented is bound to acme-temp-81 (hence 403) and an older key still in some runners had embeddings scope which explains mixed behavior.

tara_acme: oh yikes. Our CI rotated keys a few minutes ago. Might be old/new key mix. We also saw intermittent 429s earlier when running parallel scripts. Any link?

luke_support: 429s are separate: looks like trial throttle (60rpm) was hit by parallel demo traffic. We'll address but first auth fix.

izzy_sales: customer wants minimum disruption. Can infra rebind the key or issue a new key with the expected project name and scopes? Also can we do a temporary demo uplift for rate limit?

omar_infra: options: A) rebind existing key sk.test.9xyz to acme-main and add embeddings scope; B) issue a new key scoped correctly and have you rotate; C) ask you to call with header acme-temp-81. Rebind is fastest if you approve.

tara_acme: rebind please. We don't want to touch demo scripts. Also uplift throttle for next 2 hours to avoid 429s.

neha_se: security note for their questionnaire: hosted keys are tenant+project-bound and scopes are explicit (we don't grant admin/billing by default). Rotation events are audited and stored for export. We can include the exact audit entries after ops completes.

omar_infra: performing rebind now. action_id=rb_6789. Also applying demo uplift: set throttle to 300rpm for acme-org until 2026-03-21T20:00:00Z.

security_bot: Action recorded: rb_6789 by omar_infra at 2026-03-21T17:12:00Z. Quota uplift to 300rpm applied until 2026-03-21T20:00:00Z.

omar_infra: rebind complete. Updated key sk.test.9xyz bound_project=acme-main scopes=[generate,embeddings]. Logged action rb_6789.

tara_acme: retesting now... switched nothing in code and calls now return 200 for generate and embeddings. No 429s so far. Confirmed streaming works.

luke_support: following up: we'll send audit lines for rb_6789 and the uplift window. Also recommend issuing a short-lived demo key for future calls to avoid CI rotation surprises.

neha_se: follow-ups for sales: 1) provide pricing ballpark for sustained 10 qps (send estimate), 2) send security blurb for questionnaire (KMS, audit, rotation TTL), 3) file portal UX bug to show bound internal project id alongside friendly name.

izzy_sales: will do. Tara, anything else needed to close?

tara_acme: audit entries and the security blurb please. Also can you note that rotation invalidates control-plane immediately but edge cache TTL can allow old keys for short window? Their security team asked.

omar_infra: noted: immediate revoke in control plane; presales edge cache TTL was reduced to 30s and we invalidate caches on rotate for these tenants. We'll include that in the blurb.

izzy_sales: great work team, closing once audit docs are shared. :thumbsup:
